Write the FizzBuzz program for 1 to N.

Supplied answer
n = int(input("Enter N: "))
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if i % 15 == 0:
        print("FizzBuzz")
    elif i % 3 == 0:
        print("Fizz")
    elif i % 5 == 0:
        print("Buzz")
    else:
        print(i)
Note: Check 15 first. If 3 and 5 are checked first, FizzBuzz never prints. Very common test question.
